description: False-colour infrared map displaying land cover classification with delineated polygons and alphanumeric labels. The dominant colour is deep red, indicating dense, healthy vegetation. Lighter red to grayish-brown areas represent sparser vegetation or bare ground. Multiple areas are labelled with "3130", which, based on the surrounding document context, corresponds to "Forests and transitional woodlands" or "Forest in regeneration" areas. This category includes pre- or post-formation of broadleaved evergreen forest with crown cover less than 30%, abandoned agricultural land under recolonization by trees and shrubs (scattered trees or shrub cover more than 30%), abandoned peat bogs covered by scrubs and trees in recovering process, abandoned fruit tree plantations, abandoned vineyards (where original structure is not visible), shrub along river sides and on river banks, abandoned military training areas in regeneration, clear-cuts in forest areas, forest regrowth areas (not yet climax vegetation), young forest plantations (trees less than 5 m in height), forest nurseries inside forest areas, and short-rotation *Salix* beds for biomass production. Two distinct open, lighter-toned areas are labelled "3400", representing non-forest, sparsely vegetated or bare land. A partially visible label "3210" is present near a winding white-grey path, which likely corresponds to "Natural grasslands" (CORINE Land Cover 321). The map illustrates a mosaic landscape of regenerating forest/shrub and open land.
